M002.label: favourable
M002.quote: The disposition of Venus — free as it is from any malefic association — accounts for the complete absence of passions and sensual feelings even towards his own wife
M002.note: Raman presents the absence of sexual passion as a virtue from an unafflicted Venus; read as favourable for purity, though it could equally be read as virility denied.

M010.label: favourable
M010.quote: Ultimate triumph of the Divine is evident in view of the disposition of the Moon, Jupiter and Venus in Dharmatrikonas.
M010.note: Lagna itself is read for a restless, adaptable temperament; the overall summing-up is spiritual triumph and high yogic attainment.

M018.label: favourable
M018.quote: Mercury in the 10th in the constellation of Mars has given her considerable reputation as an exponent and teacher of Yoga.
M018.note: Chart No. 74 (female native); the career conclusion is found further on in the chart, beyond the packet window.

M026.label: afflicted
M026.quote: This weakens the 12th house and gives wasteful expenditure. The native took delight in horse-racing in which he lost sometimes.
M026.note: Raman adds that Jupiter in the 12th kept the native's reputation untarnished, but that is about reputation, not expenditure.

M034.label: none
M034.note: Only the timing of the marriage to Mileva is given ('the gifted mathematician'); Raman reaches no verdict on the spouse or the marriage.

M042.label: afflicted
M042.quote: the connexion between the 11th and 7th houses from the Moon gave the native two marriages, the second occurring after the death of the first husband.
M042.note: Female native; the first husband died.

M050.label: afflicted
M050.quote: the presence of Bandhana yogas or combinations for incarceration causing great suffering. Tilak suffered a lot for the country.
M050.note: Sentenced in 1897, transported for life in 1908, held at Mandalay.

M058.label: favourable
M058.quote: The native of Chart No. 105 first went abroad in the Sun's Dasa, Jupiter's Bhukti... foreign residence continues.
M058.note: Journeys and residence abroad are confirmed; Raman does not judge them good or bad beyond saying they are fulfilled.

M066.label: afflicted
M066.quote: This horoscope belongs to a gentleman, once an aristocrat, but now reduced to poverty, debts and mental torture.
M066.note: There is an earlier aristocratic phase, but Raman's verdict on the Dhana Lagna is adverse, so I read it as afflicted rather than mixed.

M074.label: favourable
M074.quote: Henry Ford as every one knows was a great industrialist, engineer and manufacturer of automobiles besides being one of the richest, if not the richest man in the world.
M074.note: 'chart 38' is NH No. 38, Henry Ford (the cited line is his birth details).

M082.label: mixed
M082.quote: These combinations no doubt gave him a robust constitution but the planet of vitality being eclipsed by Rahu rendered him ruin his health through overwork.
M082.note: Explicitly two-sided: a robust constitution, but health ruined.

M090.label: afflicted
M090.quote: But Saturn and Rahu, lending their influences, have sapped up all the vitality so that he brought ruin not only upon himself but also to his country.

M098.label: favourable
M098.quote: The 2nd and the 5th lord Jupiter and the 9th lord Moon combining in the 6th house generate a powerful yoga for gains... The native acquired immense properties

M106.label: favourable
M106.quote: The Moon's situation in the sign of the intellectual planet Mercury who in his turn is in the 10th conferred on Sankara a magnificent intellect, penetrative mind and lofty character.
M106.note: Lagna and its lord are strongly fortified; Raman also gives Alpayu (a short life), but that is a longevity judgment.

M114.label: favourable
M114.quote: Sir Ashutosh owed a good deal of his mental peculiarities and gifts to the educative influence of his father during the formative days of his youth
M114.note: The father died in 1889, when the native was about 25; Raman gives only the timing and does not call it early.

M122.label: none
M122.note: Truman's write-up never mentions his father.

M130.label: favourable
M130.quote: the Rajayogas are peculiarly balanced in the 6th (opposition and overcoming opposition), 9th (general fortune) and the 1 1th (gains and consolidation).
M130.note: This is a summary at the level of factors (Chandramangala Yoga in the 11th); there is no explicit statement about income.

M138.label: favourable
M138.quote: Mark the strong disposition of all the three factors... Consistent with the dominant positions of Mars and Saturn, the subject was a professor. Jupiter's strong disposition has rendered the native an authority on Power-Engineering.

M146.label: favourable
M146.quote: whilst the third house is not good, the third lord and Mars are well disposed with the result the native is blessed with a number of brothers and sisters.

M154.label: favourable
M154.quote: the exaltation of the 10th lord Jupiter in a spiritual sign aspected by the 12th lord Venus which has made the native a Karmayogi-cum-Jnani.
M154.note: He took to celibacy after his children were born; Raman does not use the word moksha.

M162.label: favourable
M162.quote: As owning the 9th and 10th and occupying the 7th, Saturn conferred not only fame and fortune but also marriage.
M162.note: Poet-laureate in 1850, later made a Baron.

M170.label: none
M170.note: Raman discusses the 4th/10th lord exchange only as a Raja/Parivraja yoga and the Moon as the mind; he gives no verdict on 4th-house happiness.

M178.label: afflicted
M178.quote: It is the Vidya-Karaka that is really strong. The natives' general education in the sense of school knowledge is poor. His knowledge of English is almost nil.
M178.note: Chart 121 itself says nothing on education, but HTJAH-I Chart 82 has the same birth data and gives this verdict. Raman credits strong self-study, yet his own definition of education is formal schooling.

M186.label: afflicted
M186.quote: The 8th houses and 8th lords both from Lagna and the Moon are heavily afflicted by Saturn-Mars influences. It is believed the native committed suicide

M194.label: favourable
M194.quote: Rahu's position in the 6th from Lagna is favoured as it indicates success over enemies.
M194.note: He rose to the Bench under Rahu; elsewhere Raman notes he was not robust in youth, but that comes from the Lagna.

M202.label: favourable
M202.quote: This is a unique combination indicative of great influence, wealth and power, all of which he wielded not for personal gain or pomp
M202.note: Wealth here is that of the pontiff's office; the native was an ascetic.

M210.label: favourable
M210.quote: Leadership in matters of religion and public authority are the blessings of the powerful Gajakesari Yoga present both in Rasi and Navamsa.

M218.label: afflicted
M218.quote: The native married many wives and had many mistresses ... The native spent fabulous sums on his private life.

M226.label: favourable
M226.quote: The 2nd and 5th lord in the 11th aspecting the 9th lord, Full Moon, in turn aspected by 11 th lord Mercury resulted in fabulous gains to the native.

M234.label: afflicted
M234.quote: Note the Powerful afflictions to the lord of the 7th and Venus — the Kalatrakaraka. He is a bachelor.
M234.note: Marriage denied; he turned down every offer.

M242.label: afflicted
M242.quote: The native initially suffered from night-blindness and later lost his vision completely.

M250.label: afflicted
M250.quote: On account of all these combinations, the native lost his eye-sight in the suh-period of Rahu within the major period of Jupiter.

M258.label: afflicted
M258.quote: More than anything else the heavy affliction to Venus both in Rasi and Navamsa was responsible for making the native totally blind.

M266.label: afflicted
M266.quote: The native was a President of the United States of America and was shot dead on 22-11 -1963. The 8th house, 8th lords both from Lagna and Moon are considerably afflicted by malefics.

M274.label: mixed
M274.quote: The native has an elder sister while an elder brother died. Jupiter in the 11th is welcome but 8th lord Saturn debilitated there and the papakartari to the 11th house does not augur well for elder co-borns.
M274.note: Explicitly two-sided: an elder sister survives and an elder brother died. Afflicted is defensible.

M282.label: afflicted
M282.quote: the affliction to the 9th lord Moon, especially by the nodes, resulted in the early death of father in September 1877.
M282.note: The father died five months after the birth.

M290.label: afflicted
M290.quote: The position of Rahu in the 9th indicates early death to his father.
M290.note: Raman also notes humble beginnings, from the 9th from the 9th.

M298.label: mixed
M298.quote: The mother lived till the 36th year of the native on account of the general strength of the fourth house and fourth lord. The Matru-Karaka Moon... is considerably afflicted.
M298.note: Two-sided: the mother lived long because the 4th house is strong; the afflicted karaka timed her death. Favourable is also defensible.

M306.label: afflicted
M306.quote: Houses of finance (2nd), fortune (9th) and profession (10th) have all been afflicted in some way or other... beginning from the latter part of Rahu Dasa, misfortune dogged him.
M306.note: He was a brilliant writer, but Raman's verdict on fortune and profession is frustration; he took his own life.

M314.label: afflicted
M314.quote: Though the third house is somewhat favourable, as the lord cum the Karaka is severely afflicted, the subject has no brothers.
